learning_outcomes.text: Students can identify the loads on shafts, axles, shaft-hub connections and screw connections and assign them to calculation methods.
Students can design and re-calculate shafts and their connections in mechanical engineering using professional software tools.
Students analyze the requirements and decide on possible solutions taking into account the boundary conditions.
Students design a solution for the configuration of a shaft including other components and perform calculations.

syllabus_topics: Critical speeds and moments of inertia
Loads and stresses in the drivetrain
Influences on load capacity, design factors
Design of feather keys and splined shaft connections
Design of press fits and required tolerances
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam (Klausur). The ungraded assessment is a term paper (Hausarbeit) which includes 1-2 designs of assemblies including associated calculations. It is recommended to complete the term paper before taking the exam.
